issue-form: Member ID or Name — search by membership number (e.g. MBR-2024-0041) or type the member's full name to auto-suggest
Book Title or ISBN — type at least 3 characters to search the catalog; unavailable books are greyed out
Issue Date — defaults to today's date; can be adjusted for backdated entries
Due Date — set the return deadline (default: 14 days from issue date); required field
Remarks — optional notes about the book's condition at time of issue (e.g. 'Cover slightly worn')
Issued By — auto-populated from your JWT session; displayed as read-only for audit purposes
return-form: Search Active Issues — enter the member's name, membership number, or the book's ISBN to locate the open transaction
Transaction ID — optionally enter the exact transaction ID (e.g. TXN-20240918-007) for a precise lookup
Return Date — defaults to today; adjust only for backdated corrections authorised by an admin
Book Condition on Return — select from Good, Fair, or Damaged; 'Damaged' flags the record for admin review
Overdue Fine Preview — if the return date exceeds the due date, the estimated fine (PKR 5/day) is shown before confirmation
Remarks — optional staff notes about the return (e.g. 'Pages 34–36 torn; flagged for replacement')
transaction-list: Filter by Status — All | Issued | Returned | Overdue — updates the table instantly without a page reload
Date Range Filter — select a start and end date to view transactions within a specific period
Search by Member or Book — type a name, membership number, or book title to filter rows in real time

confirmation-modal: Transaction Type — clearly labelled as ISSUE or RETURN at the top of the modal in the appropriate status colour
Member — full name and membership number (e.g. Sara Malik — MBR-2024-0027)
Book — title, author, and ISBN (e.g. Database System Concepts — Silberschatz, Korth & Sudarshan — ISBN 978-0-07-352332-3)
Issue Date & Due Date — displayed side by side for quick verification before confirming a checkout
Estimated Fine (returns only) — shown in destructive red if the return is overdue, with the per-day rate and total amount
Cancel — closes the modal without making any changes; the form retains its filled values
Confirm & Submit — writes the transaction, updates available_copies in the books collection, and logs the action to activity_logs
